title: Resolve objections with counterexamples, evidence requests and bounded debate
goal: Turn disagreement about a result, plan or check into an executable test or accountable review without letting unsupported opinion override passing evidence.
scope: Implement Objection against ResultVersion/Plan/Check with actual author, claim and optional counterexample; track Pending/Upheld/Dismissed/Unresolved and ObjectionRaised/ObjectionResolved. Resolve relevant candidate/check/criterion refs for each subject instead of assuming every objection targets the current result.

Implement CounterexampleFirst: register a supplied check as IndependentVisible, run against the applicable candidate; Fail upholds and records Contradicts/rejection, Pass dismisses, Error remains Unresolved and diagnoses Environment/CheckDefect.

Support all DisputeAction branches: RunCounterexample, RequestEvidence via admitted DesignChecks, Escalate via EscalationPolicy, and Debate with two Advocate assignments plus Judge whose outcome is recorded as Review.

Admit debate only when the judge is demonstrably weaker than both debaters using recorded strength inputs; if that cannot be established choose an evidence/escalation path. Charge advocates/judge and preserve tool permissions and producer/final-review exclusions.
acceptance: The real objection consumer demonstrates Fail/Pass/Error counterexamples producing Upheld/Dismissed/Unresolved and the corresponding evidence/diagnosis, including attributable Plan and Check subjects.

An objection without a counterexample requests evidence or escalates while a passing applicable check continues to apply. A recorded weaker-judge case runs two Advocates and a Judge; equal/stronger/unknown judge inputs deny that debate path.

CounterexampleFirst and a materially different DisputePolicy are exercised through Arbiter/AcceptanceAuthority; model opinions never override applicable executable failure, and every debate/evidence call reconciles to the session account.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.5 (Objection), 3.6 (Review), 5.3 (DisputePolicy), P4, A6/A9 and R-6/R-13. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed runtime/policies/dispute.rs with kernel Arbiter/AcceptanceAuthority integration. W3-0001 supplies ObjectionRaise, W3-0002 profile/reviewer facts, W3-0003 admitted offers and W2 actual counterexample checking.

For Plan/Check objections resolve the relevant criterion/work/snapshot without inventing a ResultVersion. Pass/Fail/Error counterexamples produce Dismissed/Upheld/Unresolved; opinion alone cannot override a passing applicable check.

Debate uses two bounded Research contributions with Advocate roles and a Judge contribution with Judge role for the same Objection. Require recorded weaker-judge evidence; neutral/unknown strength is insufficient. All calls are charged and neither debate nor a changed DisputePolicy overrides hard executable evidence.

history.note: Plan new implementation from greenfield baseline 0c61ff1, preserving approved experimental mechanisms, reporting/evidence/recovery rules and explicit prerequisite boundaries.
